name: story-faceless-long
description: Long faceless narrated video, one to twenty minutes or more: a locked look, a validated script of fixed 10-second blocks (five shots joined by four hard cuts, one narration line each), one reference-to-video clip per block, measured narration takes, an optional music bed, scripted assembly to -16 LUFS, optional captions and a 16:9 cover. Explainer, History, Kids, Fairy Tale & Myth and Picture Story (stills) channels. Use when: a faceless explainer, history documentary, kids story, fairy tale or picture story of a minute or more is ordered from a topic or script. NOT for: a short under about a minute (story-faceless-short); one-take shorts (story-one-take-short); found footage (story-found-footage); ranking shorts (story-ranking-short); a song-first sing-along with karaoke captions (story-sing-along); a script only (story-youtube-script); a presenter on camera (voice-presenter-video); captions on an existing video (edit-captions); a shot-planned film (media-video-production).
